<svg viewBox="0 0 660 716" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" role="img" aria-label="Map of Denmark during the Count's Feud, 1534 to 1536. Count Christoffer lands on Zealand in June 1534 and takes Zealand and Skaane. Skipper Clement raises the peasants of North Jutland and beats the nobility at Svenstrup in October 1534. Johan Rantzau marches north through Jutland, storms Aalborg in December 1534, crosses to Funen and wins at Oeksnebjerg in June 1535, then besieges Copenhagen until July 1536. Also marked are the towns where evangelical preaching began: Haderslev, Viborg, Malmoe and Copenhagen.">
